column5: The configured read-only executor composes planner-owned inclusive clustered signed-handle ranges, keeps only residual stored-column conditions in TiKV Selection, and returns contradictions locally before PD TSO; the server installs physical-publication observation only for queries carrying a real snapshot, so a local result cannot poison the next statement's observer slot. The full executor builder matrix, dynamic catalog, writes, joins, aggregates, partitions, indexes, and non-BIGINT types remain open.

The production real-TiKV table reader sends full, narrowed, and split signed clustered-handle key ranges without recreating a second request path; immutable plan evidence retains logical boundaries and residual Selection shape. Partition readers, paging, feedback, index lookup, virtual columns, and complete runtime statistics remain open.
